name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a high-contrast skip link at the top of every page that jumps straight to the main content. It appears only after the page finishes loading, so it never blocks first interaction. This fixes keyboard navigation for screen reader users who rely on skip links, without hurting sighted users’ experience. The trade-off is one extra HTTP request for the skip link asset, which is negligible for performance.

name: Reader
text: Ramp’s skip link still risks a race: if JavaScript loads late, the link may arrive after the user has already tabbed past where it would land, breaking keyboard flow. A server-rendered skip link inside the first 100 bytes of the HTML guarantees it’s there before any interaction starts—no flashes, no races. Settle it with a quick Playwright test that confirms the link is focusable within 100 ms of page load.
